title: model-router config, contract version 1
description: The shape of `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/model-router/config.json`. Every key is OPTIONAL; the package fills missing values with documented defaults and the file is valid when it is empty. The schema is closed: a top-level key outside `effort`, `availability`, `describe` and `$schema` is invalid (`config-key-unknown`). `$schema` is the only top-level key with a free-form value: it points editors at this file. The relationship rule (default must not be above the ceiling) is enforced by the validator, not by this schema; the file passes the schema and the engine catches the mismatch.

$schema.description: A schema URL. Editor support only; the package does not fetch it. Removed before validation; an inherited value is not a problem.

effort.description: Effort defaults the engine applies to a query. The router's answer caps routes above the ceiling and uses the default when a query carries no effort.

ceiling.description: A ladder level, in order low < medium < high < xhigh < max. Default `xhigh`.

default.description: A ladder level, in order low < medium < high < xhigh < max. Default `medium`. A value above the ceiling is rejected at validation time, not by this schema.

availability.description: How the CLI gathers an availability document when `--availability` runs. Absent means the CLI does not run the source; `--availability-file` still works because the file path comes from the flag, not from this section.

command.description: The argv the CLI runs with no shell. An entry the CLI cannot read (a non-string) is invalid.

timeoutSeconds.description: Per-run kill timeout in seconds. Default `10`.

maxAgeSeconds.description: Staleness bound applied to the document the command produced or to a `--availability-file` path. Default `300`.

describe.description: The describe step's gates and the Jev model it calls.

taskGate.description: The minimum probability a Jev task candidate needs to become the query's task. Default `0.85`.

capabilityThreshold.description: The minimum probability a Jev capability needs to be added to the query's needs. Default `0.5`.

jevModel.description: The Jev model the describe step calls. A non-empty name; the package does not validate it against Jev's catalogue. Default `jev-1.13.0`.
